title: Average Circumference (Hip)
description: Calculates the average hip circumference from explicitly configured hip circumference items on the current form, stopping before the attached average item so previously calculated summary fields are not included.

title: Average Circumference (Waist)
description: Calculates the average waist circumference from explicitly configured waist circumference items on the current form, excluding blank, canceled, and summary values.

title: Average DIA, SYS, Heart Rate
description: Calculates average systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure, or heart rate from configured vital-sign items, based on which average item the method is attached to.

title: BM_BMI
description: Calculates body mass index from height and weight values outside Screening, converting the source measurements as needed and returning the BMI rounded according to the attached item settings.

title: Baseline QtcF
description: Retrieves baseline QTcF from configured screening or predose ECG forms, selecting the relevant completed source form and returning the matching QTcF item value.

title: Common Functions
description: Provides reusable ClinSpark helper snippets for normalization, item lookup, form lookup, numeric conversion, logging, and common calculation patterns used across automation methods.

title: Difference between Baseline and Entered Value
description: Calculates the numeric change between a configured baseline value and the currently entered value, returning the delta for change-from-baseline fields or edit checks.

title: Dominant Arm (Pull from Screening)
description: Pulls the subject dominant-arm value from the configured Screening vital-sign or body-measurement form for reuse on later visit forms.

title: Edit Check QtcF (Trigger if  500 OR male  450 OR female  470 OR difference from baseline  60
description: Runs QTcF safety logic that can trigger when QTcF is at least 500 msec, exceeds sex-specific thresholds, or increases by at least 60 msec from baseline.

title: Edit Check Trigger if there is dispensed kit number
description: Triggers an edit-check response when a dispensed kit number is present, supporting kit reconciliation or conditional downstream validation.

title: Edit Check Visit Window Target Date
description: Validates that the current visit date falls within the protocol-defined visit window calculated from the configured randomization or Day 1 reference date.

title: Height (Screening)
description: Pulls the subject height value from the configured Screening body-measurements form for reuse in BMI or later-visit calculations.

title: HipWaist Circumference from Previous Visit
description: Pulls hip and waist circumference values from the mapped previous visit so current-visit derived fields can reuse prior measurements.

title: FSH and Pregnancy Test
description: Evaluates FSH and pregnancy-test logic together to determine the appropriate result or eligibility output for reproductive-status workflows.

title: Pregnancy Test
description: Evaluates pregnancy-test result values and returns the appropriate flag or response for pregnancy-related eligibility or safety logic.

title: Kit Accession Number
description: Generates or validates kit accession numbers using the Day 1 prefix logic and configured kit fields for study-specific kit tracking.

title: Last Meal Time
description: Captures the subject last-meal time from configured source items and formats it for the target output field.

title: POCBP or Partner POCBP
description: Determines the appropriate POCBP or partner POCBP response from configured subject or partner reproductive-potential fields.

title: Process No.
description: Generates, retrieves, or tracks process numbers for lab sample workflows so related samples can share the correct process identifier.

title: Protocol Check Any QTcF increase ≥60 msec from Baseline OR average QTcF 500 msec
description: Runs a repeat-form QTcF protocol check that flags subjects with any QTcF increase of at least 60 msec from baseline or an average QTcF of at least 500 msec.

title: Protocol Check Is BMI within range
description: Validates BMI against protocol-defined lower and upper limits and returns the configured protocol-check output for in-range or out-of-range values.

title: Protocol Check Vital Signs Range
description: Checks vital-sign values against general protocol ranges using configured item lists and returns the appropriate in-range or out-of-range result.

title: QTcF (Screening)
description: Pulls or computes the QTcF value from configured Screening ECG forms so later methods can reuse the screening QTcF baseline.

title: Sample Barcode
description: Validates and formats sample barcode values by matching the current sample context to the configured sample barcode item list.

title: Subject's Initials
description: Returns the subject initials from available subject-identifying fields for use in target initials fields.

title: Target Date
description: Calculates target visit-date ranges from the configured randomization or Day 1 reference date and the protocol visit-window map.

title: Total Urine Volume
description: Calculates total urine volume across configured collection intervals by summing valid interval volume values from the current form.

title: Total Urine Weight
description: Calculates net urine weight by subtracting the empty jug weight from the jug-plus-urine weight on the current form.

title: Transfer Barcode
description: Validates and formats transfer barcode values by matching transfer sample context and returning the appropriate barcode output.

title: Tween-20 DateTime is more than 1 hour after PCVOID
description: Validates that Tween-20 datetime occurs more than one hour after the PCVOID datetime for the urine collection interval.

title: Tween-20 Volume = (Urine Volume)10
description: Calculates Tween-20 additive volume as one tenth of the urine volume and returns the result for the Tween-20 volume field.

title: Waist to Height Ratio
description: Calculates waist-to-height ratio from configured waist and height measurements, using current or pulled source values as available.

title: Waist to Hip Ratio
description: Calculates waist-to-hip ratio from configured waist and hip circumference measurements, using current or pulled source values as available.

title: Average Height
description: Calculates average height from explicitly configured height measurement items on the current form, excluding blank or canceled entries and summary fields.

title: Average Weight
description: Calculates average weight from explicitly configured weight measurement items on the current form, excluding blank or canceled entries and summary fields.

title: Year of Birth
description: Extracts the subject year of birth from the volunteer date-of-birth value and returns only the four-digit year.

title: After-Dose
description: Calculates an end-of-interval datetime by reading a dose administration datetime from the configured Day 1 dose form, deriving the hour interval from the current study event name, and returning the resulting ClinSpark datetime value for downstream form population.

title: Edit Check Void Interval Check
description: Validates urine void interval sequencing by comparing start and end void times and returning false when intervals are missing, overlapping, or out of order.

title: Edit Check Tween-20 datetime is 1 hour after PCVOID
description: Validates that the Tween-20 datetime is exactly one hour after the PCVOID reference datetime for the same collection workflow.

title: Total Urine Weight v2
description: Calculates net urine weight from jug-plus-urine and empty-jug items with updated item matching for v2 urine collection forms.

title: Protocol Check Average Vital Signs Range SYS, DIA
description: Checks averaged systolic and diastolic blood pressure values against protocol-defined vital-sign ranges using configured source items.

title: Function Is Within Last Year
description: Returns true when the supplied date falls within the last 365 days relative to the current date, and false when it is older or invalid.

title: Dipstick Result for ALL
description: Evaluates urine dipstick result items across the current form and returns a consolidated flag or result based on configured abnormal-result logic.

title: Edit Check Transfer Barcode Contains T
description: Validates that transfer barcode entries include the required T prefix or marker before allowing the barcode to pass the edit check.

title: Edit Check Range check for any (HR, SYS, DIA, VS, ECG, QtcF, QTC, QT)
description: Applies a lightweight item-name-driven range check for common vital-sign or ECG parameters when a narrower reusable edit check is sufficient.

title: Average Height & Weight
description: Calculates average height or average weight from configured measurement items, selecting the metric from the attached average item and ignoring summary values.

title: Average Circumference (Hip + Waist)
description: Calculates the combined hip-plus-waist value by averaging the configured hip and waist circumference measurements separately and returning the sum of those averages.

title: Average PR, QRS, QT, QTCF, HR
description: Calculates average ECG interval or heart-rate values from configured ECG measurement items, with broader item-name matching for PR, QRS, QT, QTcF, and HR fields.

title: Edit Check Range check for ALL (HR, SYS, DIA, PR, RR, QtcF, QTC, QRS, QT)
description: Applies comprehensive range checks for standard vital-sign and ECG parameters, including HR, SYS, DIA, PR, RR, QTcF, QTC, QRS, and QT.

title: Edit Check Kit Accession Number Format
description: Validates kit accession number formatting against the expected study pattern so malformed kit identifiers can be queried before downstream use.

title: Protocol Check If QTcF above 450 for male or 470 for female
description: Applies sex-specific QTcF protocol thresholds and returns the protocol-check result when male QTcF exceeds 450 msec or female QTcF exceeds 470 msec.

title: BMI Pull From Screening
description: Pulls the subject BMI value from the configured Screening body-measurements form and returns it for use on later forms or visits.

title: LDL Reduction Calculation
description: Calculates percent LDL reduction by comparing baseline LDL with the current LDL value and returning the rounded percentage change.

title: LDL Titration Decision
description: Determines the LDL titration decision from LDL reduction percentage and protocol thresholds, returning the appropriate dosing or decision output.

title: Glycemia Next Step
description: Determines the next glucose-monitoring action based on prior glycemia readings and configured study decision thresholds.

title: Edit Check Item Name Range
description: Performs a configurable numeric range check based on the current item name, returning false when the value falls outside the allowed item-specific range.

title: Edit Check Difference between Start Time and Collection Time (Minutes Only)
description: Validates that collection time occurs at least the configured number of whole minutes after a start time, using minute-level comparison to avoid second-level rounding issues.

title: Edit Check Visit Window Target Date V2
description: Validates visit-window dates from the current study event by using Day 1 IP start date as the anchor, comparing date-only values, and applying the protocol window for later Day visits.

title: Edit Check Check if collected date is future date
description: Returns false when the current collected date is later than today, allowing ClinSpark to query future-dated collection entries.

title: Edit Check Sample is Out of Window
description: Checks sample collection timing against configured nominal windows and returns false when the sample is collected outside the allowed lower or upper bounds.

title: Unique Incremental ID Number
description: Generates the next unique incremental ID by scanning existing IDs across study events and returning the next available number.

title: Outpatient Visit Window
description: Calculates outpatient visit-window guidance or validation output from the current study event and configured protocol visit-window rules.

title: Collect All Transfer Barcode
description: Collects transfer barcode values from related item data and combines them into a single output for downstream transfer or reconciliation fields.

title: Expected Number of Tablets Returned
description: Calculates the expected number of tablets returned from prior visit date, dispensed quantity, prescribed daily dose, and current visit timing.

title: Calculate Current Dosing Level
description: Determines the current dosing level by reading the most recent kit label and tablet-count data from configured dose forms, then mapping that data to the appropriate dosing level output.

title: Unique Incremental ID Number (repeated item groups and repeated forms)
description: Generates unique incremental IDs within repeated item groups and repeated forms by finding the highest existing value and returning the next number.

title: Datetime functions
description: Provides reusable ClinSpark datetime helper snippets for adding time offsets, parsing date/time strings, formatting outputs, and handling time-window calculations.

title: Calculate Post Dose Window
description: Returns the valid 30- to 45-minute post-dose assessment time window by reading the administration datetime from the same item group and formatting the lower and upper time bounds.

title: Average
description: Calculates average PR, QRS, QT, QTcF, or HR values from the current form with repeat and non-repeat support, using the attached item to determine which ECG metric should be averaged.

title: Difference between 2 SBP, DBP, and HR - Supine vs Standing (Orthostasis)
description: Calculates the orthostatic difference between supine and standing SBP, DBP, or HR values from same-named configured items, supporting both repeat and non-repeat item groups.

title: Median HR, RR, PR, QRS, QT, QTC, QTcF
description: Calculates median ECG or rate values for non-repeat forms by collecting matching HR, RR, PR, QRS, QT, QTC, or QTcF items before the attached median field.

title: Protocol Check Is (AVERAGE) QTcFQRS Out of Range
description: Checks non-repeat averaged QTcF and QRS values against protocol out-of-range thresholds and returns the corresponding protocol-check response.

title: Pull ECG Collection Time for Vitals
description: Pulls and formats the ECG collection or supine start time from a completed ECG form in the same study event for use on vital-sign forms.

title: Pull Weight
description: Pulls the subject weight value from the configured Screening body-measurements form for reuse in later calculations or visit forms.

title: Difference between 2 SBP, DBP, and HR - Supine vs Standing (Orthostasis) v2
description: Calculates the numeric orthostatic difference between supine or semi-recumbent and standing vitals using improved metric detection for SBP, DBP, and HR.

title: Protocol Check Median Vital Sign Eligibility
description: Calculates non-repeat median vital-sign values and applies protocol eligibility logic for vital-sign inclusion or exclusion criteria.

title: Conmeds Pull Adverse Event
description: Populates a concomitant-medication adverse-event field by locating and returning the related adverse event value from the current or associated item group.

title: Protocol Check Median ECG Eligibility
description: Calculates non-repeat median ECG values and applies protocol eligibility logic for ECG-related inclusion or exclusion criteria.

title: Pull ECG Start Time for Vitals (VS)
description: Pulls the ECG start time for vital-sign forms from the most recent completed ECG form, preferring same-event ECG data when available.

title: Edit Check Difference between Start Time and Collection Time (Minutes Only) (if used on Vital Sign Form that Pulls from ECG).js
description: Validates vital-sign collection timing against ECG-derived start times, accounting for same-as-ECG selections and using minute-level comparison for the configured interval.

title: Combine Alcohol Substance Use (SU) Queries.js
description: Combines alcohol and substance-use query text by normalizing frequency and use-response values, producing consolidated query wording for data-transfer or review workflows.

title: Edit Check Check if item date value has at least the year.js
description: Validates partial or complete date entries by requiring at least a year component, and raises a custom message when the date is blank or missing the year.

title: Average PR, QRS, QT, QTCF, HR v2.js
description: Calculates average ECG interval or heart-rate values by detecting PR, QRS, QT, QTcF, and HR source items automatically, including repeat-aware collection logic and summary-field exclusion.

title: Edit Check Supine time must be the same as original.js
description: Validates that repeat-form supine or semi-recumbent start time matches the original source time when the repeat assessment is marked as same as original.

title: Average Circumference (Hip) v2
description: Calculates the average hip circumference by detecting hip measurement items from their names instead of relying on configured item lists, with support for repeat and non-repeat item groups.

title: Average Circumference (Waist) v2
description: Calculates the average waist circumference by detecting waist measurement items from their names instead of relying on configured item lists, with support for repeat and non-repeat item groups.

title: Average Circumference (Hip + Waist) v2
description: Calculates the combined hip-plus-waist value by auto-detecting hip and waist measurement items, averaging each metric independently, and returning the sum without configured item-name lists.

title: Average Height v2
description: Calculates average height by detecting height measurement items from their names, supporting repeat and non-repeat item groups without configured item-name lists.

title: Average Weight v2
description: Calculates average weight by detecting weight measurement items from their names, supporting repeat and non-repeat item groups without configured item-name lists.

title: Average Height & Weight v2
description: Calculates average height or average weight by detecting matching measurement items from their names, supporting repeat and non-repeat item groups without configured item-name lists.

title: Median HR, RR, PR, QRS, QT, QTC, QTcF v2
description: Calculates median ECG or vital values from the attached median item, auto-detecting HR, RR, PR, QRS, QT, QTC, QTcF, SYS, or DIA source values across repeat and non-repeat item groups and logging collected values.

title: Protocol Check Average Vital Signs Range SYS, DIA v2
description: Checks averaged systolic and diastolic blood pressure values against protocol ranges while auto-detecting source items instead of relying on configured item-name lists.

title: Protocol Check Is (AVERAGE) QTcFQRS Out of Range v2
description: Checks averaged QTcF and QRS values against protocol thresholds using auto-detected ECG source items, reducing configured item-name dependencies.

title: Protocol Check Median ECG Eligibility v2
description: Applies ECG eligibility rules using median HR and PR plus QTcF summary logic, with auto-detected source items and repeat-aware collection.

title: Protocol Check Median Vital Sign Eligibility v2
description: Applies vital-sign eligibility rules using median SYS, DIA, and HR values with auto-detected source items and repeat-aware collection.

title: Protocol Check Vital Signs Range v2
description: Checks vital-sign values against protocol ranges while auto-detecting source items from their names instead of requiring configured item-name lists.

title: Average DIA, SYS, Heart Rate v2
description: Calculates average systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure, or heart rate by detecting matching vital-sign item names automatically, reducing the need for study-specific item configuration.

title: Expected Days
description: Calculates the expected number of days between the current visit and its prior mapped visit by pulling the prior visit date from configured review forms.

title: ECG Interpretation Cleaner (For Data Transfer)
description: Cleans ECG interpretation text for data transfer by finding the target ECG text item in the same item group and normalizing the output format.

title: Difference between 2 SBP, DBP, and HR - Supine vs Standing (Orthostasis) v3
description: Calculates orthostatic differences by auto-detecting supine or semi-recumbent and standing SBP, DBP, or HR values, with broader support for naming variations.

title: Difference between 2 SBP, DBP, and HR - Supine vs Standing (Orthostasis) v4
description: Calculates orthostatic SBP, DBP, or HR differences with expanded repeat-aware item matching and summary-field handling for vital-sign forms.

title: Median SYS, DIA, and HR
description: Calculates median systolic BP, diastolic BP, or heart-rate values by detecting matching vital-sign items from the attached median item without configured source item names.

title: Protocol Check Vital Signs Range v3
description: Calculates average SYS, DIA, and HR values from detected source items and checks the averaged results against protocol ranges.

title: Protocol Check Vital Signs Range v4
description: Checks protocol vital-sign ranges using median, average, or orthostatic SYS, DIA, and HR logic depending on the attached item and available source values.

title: Difference between 2 SBP, DBP, and HR - Supine vs Standing (Orthostasis) - Different Forms v4
description: Calculates orthostatic SBP, DBP, or HR differences when supine or semi-recumbent values and standing values are collected on different forms, using configured form lookup and v4 metric matching.

title: Check if AE occur within 24 hours of dosing
description: Determines whether the current AE onset datetime occurred within 24 hours after the nearest valid acetaminophen administration dose from configured D-1 or Day 84 source events.

title: Orthostasis + Triplicate Median Calculation
description: Calculates the difference between a standing vital-sign value and the median of three matching supine or semi-recumbent triplicate values for orthostasis workflows.
